Registered presets of earthflux()

Source: R/api-presets.R
ef_presets.Rd

Lists the presets that earthflux() accepts: a preset is a named, documented and versioned set of every scientific option of the workflow (decision M5-04). Use ef_preset() to see every option of one preset.

Usage

ef_presets()

Value

A data frame with one row per preset: name, version, status (verification status of the preset as a whole: "VERIFICADA" only when every formulation and option is) and description.

Verification status

Both presets are CANDIDATA (decision M5-09): their forms are those of the SEBAL Idaho manual (Waters et al., 2002), mostly VERIFICADA (SEBAL-Idaho 2002), but the anchor criteria, the MODIS albedo and the regionalization, among others, are not verified. The unverified elements are listed in ef_preset(name)$unverified and in the warning of earthflux().

See also

ef_preset(), earthflux().

Other workflow functions: earthflux(), ef_preset()

Examples

ef_presets()
#>             name version    status
#> 1 idaho2002_elev       3 CANDIDATA
#> 2 idaho2002_flat       3 CANDIDATA
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             description
#> 1 SEBAL-Idaho 2002 forms with the elevation adjustments of appendix 12 of the manual (datum surface temperature with a lapse rate of 0.0065 K/m, cold-pixel temperature of the incoming longwave adjusted by elevation, shortwave transmissivity per pixel); flat projection (slope 0).
#> 2                                         Base procedure of the SEBAL-Idaho 2002 manual for low relief: no lapse rate in the datum surface temperature, one cold-pixel temperature for the incoming longwave and one shortwave transmissivity for the scene; flat projection (slope 0).
